200-amp Service Upgrade
- Shut down power at the panel and remove the meter.
- Disconnect taps and remove 100-amp service cable, meter socket.
- Remove service cable from 100-amp main breaker panel.
- Remove the 100-amp main breaker panel.
- Supply and install 200-amp service cable, PVC weather head strap securely to the building to the new meter socket.
- Supply and install a 200-amp aerial-fed meter socket with a weather-proof hub.
- Supply and install an emergency disconnect near the meter.  
- Supply and install a 200-amp, 40-space, main breaker load center.
- Supply wiring from the new meter socket to the emergency disconnect, then to the main breaker of the new load center panel.
- Supply all required bonding and grounding of the new service.
- Supply and install all required branch circuit breakers.
- Make all mains and branch circuit terminations.
- Identify circuits and place panel schedule.
- Prepare a drip leg and make insulated splice connection to Peco feeders.
- Reinstall the meter into the socket, energize, and test circuits.

- Supply and install dedicated 20-amp living room receptacle. 

- Install (2) customer supplied wall sconces in second floor hall bath in place of existing medicine cabinet fixtures. Supply and install necessary switching circuit and switch.

- Install customer supplied light in place of ceiling fan in rear bedroom of second floor.  

- Install (4) customer supplied light fixtures in place of existing exterior entry lights.  Supply and install new fixture boxes as needed at each fixture.

- Supply and install (6) 4" LED recessed wafer lights in ceiling of living room.  Supply and install all necessary wiring, dimmer and plate.  

- Supply and install (4) 4" LED recessed wafer lights in ceiling of dining room.  Supply and install all necessary wiring, box, dimmer and plate.  

- Supply and install (4) 4" LED recessed wafer lights

properties.description:
SERVICE UPGRADE
- Shut down power at panel and remove
meter.
- Disconnect taps and remove 100 amp
service cable, meter socket.
- Remove service cable from 100A main
breaker panel.
- Remove 100A main breaker panel.
- Supply and install 200 Amp service cable,
PVC weather head strap securely to building
and to new disconnect and meter socket.
- Supply and install a 200 Amp aerial fed
meter socket with weather-proof hub.
- Supply and install a 200 amp, 40 space,
main breaker load center
- Supply wiring from new meter socket to
main breaker of new load center panel.
- Supply all required bonding and grounding
of new service.
- Supply and install all required branch circuit
breakers.
- Make all mains and branch circuit
terminations.
- Identify circuits and place panel schedule.
- Prepare a drip leg and make insulated
splice connection to Peco feeders.
- Re-install meter into socket, energize and
test circuits.
